Vendor mengirimkan barang fisik ke area: Vendor delivers physical goods to the PT Pupuk Kalimantan Timur Warehouse receiving area. The Expediting team monitors the logistics shipment. Subsequently, Receiving staff receives, matches SAP PO numbers, checks package physical condition, delivery order (DO), and vendor attachment documents before further processing.
Khusus komoditas <strong>Chemical &amp;: Specifically for Chemicals & Raw Materials (e.g. process chemicals, NPK raw materials, packaging sacks): Receiving staff submits a QC/JOR request. The LAB unit collects samples and performs chemical testing, then issues a COA (Certificate of Analysis). Next, the PPE unit evaluates quality conformance against plant technical standards to decide whether goods are Accepted or Rejected.
Khusus kategori <strong>Sparepart</stron: Specifically for Spare Parts (mechanical, electrical, instrumentation parts): Receiving staff issues a QC Request via transmittal to ISTEK 2 (Technical Inspection 2) unit. The ISTEK 2 team conducts direct field inspections (visual check, dimensions, part number, mill certificate, and operating tolerance) to determine whether goods are Accepted or Rejected.
Apabila hasil pemeriksaan (dari ISTEK 2: If inspection results (from ISTEK 2 for spare parts or PPE for chemicals) state ACCEPTED: Receiving staff issues the official Goods Receipt Slip (GRS / MIGO SAP 105) document. Materials are officially recognized in corporate system inventory and physical goods are handed over to Warehouse for storage and arrangement in appropriate racks/staging locations.
Apabila hasil pemeriksaan mutu menyataka: If quality inspection states REJECTED (mismatched specs, incomplete docs, or lab test results below threshold): Receiving staff issues RDTV (Return Delivery to Vendor) document. Expediting unit monitors rejection status, and Vendor receives official rejection notice to promptly follow up with item replacement, certificate revision, or physical goods return.
